timelineImport.title: Import a CSV timeline for {name}
timelineImport.intro: A spreadsheet or an app or device export: one row per date with a column per measurement, or one reading per row. You say what each column is; nothing leaves this device.
timelineImport.notATable: This does not look like a table with a header row.
timelineImport.shape.wide: One row per date, one column per measurement
timelineImport.shape.long: One reading per row (name, value, unit)
timelineImport.role.name: measurement name
timelineImport.ambiguousDate: Every date in this file reads both as day/month and as month/day. Check the date format above.
timelineImport.needDate: Choose which column holds the date.
timelineImport.skip.pairIncomplete: {n} blood-pressure rows with only one of the two numbers
timelineImport.blocked: {metric} in {unit} cannot be converted; pick the right unit or untick the column.
